item.title: Wishing a Non-Jew Merry Christmas or Happy New Year
item.description:
Daily Halacha — Avodah Zara and December Halachic Common Questions Dayan Daniel Kada
Clarification from the previous shiur: it is forbidden to say "Christ" when it is used as an adjective of honour. It is permissible to say Christ's College / Trinity Hall / Christchurch, for the same reasons explained that one is allowed to say Christmas.
▶ Watch on YouTube: https://youtu.be/ArDJqQs56SY
